title: The Antikythera Mechanism, Opened Up
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Mediterranean Travels
description: Hover over nine numbered parts of the Antikythera mechanism, the crank, the gear train, and the front and back dials, to match each to the question an owner could ask of it, then test yourself in Quiz mode.

learningObjectives: The learner will name the main parts of the Antikythera mechanism, the crank, the gear train, and the front and back dials, and match each dial to the question an owner could ask of it, from the Moon's phase to the next eclipse.
prerequisites: The Antikythera mechanism and ancient prediction machines, from [Chapter 20](../../chapters/20-athens-museums-city-today/index.md).

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Interactive exploration followed by retrieval practice
commonMisconceptions: It was a computer in the modern sense.
assessmentOpportunities: Quiz mode: identify each marked part from its description

controls.name: Explore
controls.description: Default mode: hover a marker or label to read about that part.

controls.name: Quiz
controls.description: Hides the labels and asks you to click the marker that matches each description.
